## Proprietary Technology & Differentiators
1. **Sub-40°C Low-Thermal Dehydration**: Biomass is gently dehydrated under sub-40°C controlled airflow, protecting heat-sensitive phycobiliproteins, enzymes, and delicate polyunsaturated fatty acids from heat oxidation.
2. **Bio-Secure Aquaculture Cultivation**: Cultivated in isolated, alkaline deep-bore water systems shielded from airborne industrial pollution, bird contaminants, and wild surface algal strains.
3. **Clean-Label Zero Binders**: Free from synthetic excipients, talc, magnesium stearate, and artificial tableting binders. Fresh, clean natural earthy scent without rotten swamp odors.
